title: Several psqlODBC entry points use an application-supplied column number or row index as an array… (CVE-2026-120064)
description: CVE-2026-120064 is a vulnerability in psqlODBC versions before 18.00.0006 where several entry points improperly use application-supplied column numbers or row indexes as array indexes without validation. This can lead to out-of-bounds reads and writes when untrusted inputs are forwarded, potentially causing memory corruption.
